open_points.subject: M07 PublicationMark.marked_at
open_points.question: What source supplies `marked_at`, in what representation and time zone is it stored, and exactly how many readings does a mark operation take, including replay and refusal paths?
options: Read an injected system clock exactly once when creating a new mark, store naive UTC, and take no reading for replay or refusal
Read an injected system clock exactly once and store an offset-aware UTC datetime
Accept the instant from the caller
Use another authority or permit multiple clock readings
open_points.default_guess: Use the State 2 system-clock authority, read it exactly once only when a new mark is committed, store UTC without an offset, and preserve the stored value without reading the clock on replay or refusal.

witness.initial: A placement exists and has no publication mark.
events: The calling flow reports a Portal photo_id and asks the service to create the mark.
outcomes: The service reads its clock once, stores a naive UTC marked_at, and returns MARKED.
The service uses caller time, an offset-aware datetime, local time, or one of several clock readings for marked_at and returns MARKED.
witness.observer: A reader of the durable PublicationMark record or a check comparing generated implementations sees a different instant or representation.

open_points.subject: A3 INV-06 Required tests
open_points.text: - INV-06: a second placement returns the first publication and leaves every stored image and placement record unchanged, with one placement record in place (`test_a_repeated_placement_writes_no_durable_state`). When no refusal of A6 rule 5 applies, a delivery repeated after a failed record write completes the placement (`test_a_delivery_repeated_after_a_failed_record_write_completes`).
open_points.question: What must the INV-06 test show to establish the invariant that a repeated placement writes nothing and the changed rule 2 requirement that it creates or changes no mark, rather than merely showing unchanged final stored images and placement records?
options: Assert that the repeated delivery performs no durable write at all and creates or changes no mark, stored image or placement record
Assert only final-state equality of stored images and placement records
Narrow INV-06 and A3 rule 2 so that mark or other writes are permitted
open_points.default_guess: Require a write trace showing zero durable writes during replay and explicit before-and-after assertions that all placement, stored-image and mark state is unchanged.
